steps.actual: Personal group true; name Saved true, after reload "DOC-029 access Administrator 39040 edited", header menu updated true; timezone Saved true, after reload "Asia/Tokyo"; Use browser timezone Saved true, stored null; Email shown and not editable true; Role note true

steps.step: Profile photo: Upload a PNG within 1 MB; a larger file fails
steps.expected: A JPG or PNG no larger than 1 MB saves; a failed update is reported
steps.actual: 64 px PNG (12420 bytes) Saved true, stored true; 1470983-byte PNG shows The change could not be saved. Try again. true

steps.step: Choose a theme, steps 1-3; another account unchanged
steps.expected: Light, Warm and Dark each save for this account; reload keeps the choice; changing theme does not sign out; the other account's preferences stay the same
steps.actual: Saved/stored: {"Warm":"true/warm","Dark":"true/dark","Light":"true/light"}; Dark kept after reload true (document theme "dark"); still signed in true; other legal_team_member account name|timezone|theme|photo before "|light|false", after "|light|false", equal true

steps.step: Open your own Portal view, steps 1-4
steps.expected: View Business Portal under Personal; View as business user opens the Portal with the Viewing as business user banner; it is your own identity and role; Return to legal view returns to View Business Portal

steps.step: Change your password, steps 1-3

steps.step: End sessions: Sign out other devices and Sign out

steps.actual: Saved true; other device sent to sign-in true; this session still open true; name restored with Enter true; Sign out -> sign-in page true; protected page afterwards requires sign-in true
